# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest Bubbles Word Writer `2.5.x` release. Older releases are not supported.

## Reporting A Vulnerability

Do not report vulnerabilities in a public issue, discussion, pull request, or social-media post.

1. Open the [repository Security page](https://github.com/KernFerm/BubblesWordWriter/security).
2. Select **Report a vulnerability**.
3. Submit the report privately through GitHub's security advisory form.

Include the affected version, Windows version, impact, reproduction steps, required user interaction, and a minimal proof of concept using non-sensitive data. Do not attach real documents, passwords, credentials, access tokens, private room names, or personal information.

If private vulnerability reporting is unavailable, contact the repository owner privately through the [KernFerm GitHub profile](https://github.com/KernFerm). Do not publish exploit details while trying to make contact.

## Full Policy

Read the complete [Bubbles Word Writer Security Policy](../DOCS/SECURITY.md) for scope, response procedures, safe-research guidelines, privacy, application protections, dependency scanning, installer verification, disclosure, and reporter credit.
